generation_guards: Show exactly three bagels, exactly four pigs, and exactly six candles.
Bind white color only to the three bagels and yellow color only to the six candles.
Arrange the three white bagels behind the four pigs, with all three bagels at least partially visible and clearly countable.
Arrange the four pigs under the six yellow candles, with the candles above the pigs and the pigs clearly below them.
Keep objects separated enough to count; avoid hiding any pig, bagel, or candle behind another object.
initial_plan.generation_strategy: Use a clear layered spatial composition: back row has three white bagels, middle/lower row has four pigs in front of the bagels, and top row has six yellow candles above the pigs. Keep every object distinct, fully or mostly visible, and non-overlapping enough for reliable counting while preserving the behind and under relationships.
initial_plan.initial_prompt: Create a clear image with exactly three white bagels, exactly four pigs, and exactly six yellow candles. Place the three white bagels in a back row behind the four pigs, with all three bagels visible and countable. Place the four pigs in front of the bagels and below the candles. Place the six yellow candles above the pigs, so the pigs are under the candles. Keep all objects separated enough to count clearly, with no extra bagels, pigs, or candles and no occlusion that hides any object.
